evidence_items.observed_summary: The guide defines bounded rechecks, evidence-linked lesson recording, promotion choices, and future-use reopening; these are source instructions, not observed effectiveness.
The skill entrypoint routes relevant substantive review and learning work to the packaged guide while retaining its existing evidence and authorization requirements.
Publication and fresh consumer activation are separate lifecycle gates; this source inspection does not execute them.
